releaseNotes: Photos now refresh directly from Android MediaStore and resync quietly when Smart Life returns to the foreground. Recent is ordered by when an image was added to the phone, so newly downloaded Gmail/Downloads images appear at the top even when their original capture date is older. The existing photo selection actions remain intact. Theme colors are expanded with Midnight Navy, Royal Blue, Deep Teal, Emerald, Forest Green, Burgundy, Plum, Royal Purple, Charcoal, Slate Blue, Coffee Brown, Champagne Gold, and the existing palettes in a scrollable color picker.
